blocks.html:
CURIOUS HOW SHE DID IT? HERE'S HOW....
 

HERE'S THE STORY...
YOUR NEIGHBOR CALLED ME...

She was ready to sell because she needed to move closer to her mom.

I GOT TO WORK…

I immediately sent out postcards, created a captivating video, arranged for professional photos, and scheduled open houses to showcase her beautiful home.

A BUZZWORTHY LAUNCH...
My marketing efforts generated significant interest, leading to 17 showings in just two weeks.

THE OFFER…
Within two weeks, we received a full-priced offer, which was almost $10,000 more than Zillow's estimate, ensuring a smooth transition for my client.

MASTERFUL MARKETING...
My aggressive social media and online marketing created urgency and allowed my Seller to hold firm on the price and terms.

111 2nd St, Ault
My marketing strategy and implementation resulted in these sweet results:

17 Showings in Just Two Weeks
$355,000 Under Contract Price
$117,000 Increase in Value
Almost $10,000 More Than Zillow's Estimate
Approximately $301.61 Per Square Foot
Significant Online Interest and Engagement

TESTIMONIAL
"Christine did an excellent job selling my home! She made everything easy and explained things every step of the way. I would highly recommend her and her team!" – Kerry
